                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • DailyMed (ChEMBL mechanism reference): setid=24d10449-2936-4cd3-b7db-a7683db721e4#section-15 (citation verified: False)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Evidence against

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Antineoplastic agent (ATC L01): its use requires a tumour context and may increase toxicity in healthy tissue. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Has a boxed warning in ChEMBL. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Inhibits a component of the module: in a weakened-checkpoint context it could worsen chromosomal instability; the direction must be reviewed. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The label mentions hematologic. [DailyMed keyword scan (heuristic)]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The label mentions hypersensitivity. [DailyMed keyword scan (heuristic)]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ALCOHOL: ethanol content, relevant in children. [excipient review (author-curated list)]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • POLYOXYL 35 CASTOR OIL: polyoxyl castor oil vehicles are associated with anaphylactoid reactions. [excipient review (author-curated list)]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The label lists hypersensitivity among its contraindications. [DailyMed contraindications (heuristic)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Direction review

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • caveat: provisional; GO annotation-based; applies only to the spindle checkpoint module; other modules are not assessed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Evidence against

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Antineoplastic agent (ATC L01): its use requires a tumour context and may increase toxicity in healthy tissue. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Has a boxed warning in ChEMBL. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Inhibits a component of the module: in a weakened-checkpoint context it could worsen chromosomal instability; the direction must be reviewed. [rule]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The label mentions embryo_fetal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     • The label mentions neurologic.
